mapper.select:
SELECT B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, LB.lbidx, LB.code, LB.callName, LB.location, LB.dueDate, LB.status FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N'
ORDER BY LB.lbidx DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N'
SELECT * FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx JOIN CATEGORY AS C ON LB.cidx = C.cidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N' AND lbidx = #{lbidx};
mapper.update: update LIBRARYBOOKS set delyn='Y', modify=now() where lbidx=#{lbidx}
mapper.select: SELECT LB.code FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB ORDER BY LB.lbidx DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM LIBRARYBOOKS WHERE callName = #{callName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIBRARYBOOKS (bidx, cidx, aidx, code, callName, location, loanDate, dueDate, returnDate, status) VALUES (#{bidx},#{cidx},#{aidx},#{code},#{callName},#{location},null,null,null,#{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx JOIN APPROVAL AS A ON LB.aidx = A.aidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(LB.regDate, '%Y%m%d') = #{today} AND A.regyn='Y'

SELECT B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, LB.lbidx, LB.bidx, LB.code, LB.callName, LB.location FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx JOIN APPROVAL AS A ON LB.aidx = A.aidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(LB.regDate, '%Y%m%d') = #{today} AND A.regyn='Y' ORDER BY LB.lbidx DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};
SELECT aidx FROM LIBRARYBOOKS where lbidx=#{lbidx}
mapper.update: update LIBRARYBOOKS set callName = #{callName}, location = #{location}, cidx = #{cidx}, status = #{status}, modify=now() where lbidx=#{lbidx}
